channel.title: Journeys In Japan
channel.desc: Seto City, in Aichi Prefecture, is a leading ceramic hub, and also one of the Six Ancient Kilns of Japan .\nIts pottery tradition has continued uninterrupted for over 1,000 years. \nCeramics are seen everywhere in stores, workshops and galleries, and even the landscape. Estella Mak, who is originally from Hong Kong, explores Seto, a pottery town filled with exceptional charms.
